decisions.statement: A record's fields are judged against the record property that declares those fields.
An entry beside the page is judged against the fields its property declares.
The fields of a group are the members that group's page type declares.
A member the group holds in a file is no field of the group.
A value that is no plain object has no field.
A field whose property declares fields is opened against what declares them.
Such a field holding what is no record gives a reason rather than being passed.
A property keeping its values beside the page declares no record here.
A property whose page type is under `page-property-entry` keeps its values beside the page.
A field whose property names members is opened against the members it names.
The one member declaring fields is what a record among them is judged against.
A value is passed over where a member of that property declares no field.
A property whose members declare fields more than once holds each of them.
A record among those members is judged against the one member its fields fit.
A record fits a member declaring every key that record states.
A record fits a member only where it states every key that member requires.
A record fitting no one member gives a reason rather than being passed over.
No value a record states picks the member that record is judged against.
The fields a declaration opens are read through the reader the caller hands in.
A numbered entry file beside the page is judged as the first file is judged.
An entry file is read once rather than looked for and then read.
A field the shape requires and the row leaves out gives a reason.
A field the shape keeps elsewhere or fixes or works out is not asked for.
An entry's own id is not judged as a field of the shape declaring the entry.
An entry with no id refuses the page.
An entry file that will not read refuses the page.
The rows of one entry file are judged before the next file is read.
A file that will not read leaves the rows judged before it giving no reason.
A file that will not read leaves the files after it unread.

definition: the reasons the fields of a record and of an entry give against what declares them
